caseNameFull: Harry A. Van Auken v. Frank Smith, Sheriff of Larimer County, Colorado
attorneys: Mr. Paul W. Lee and Mr. George H. Shaw for plaintiff in error. No brief filed for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5, 6.
